Observed problem: No image-file decode path existed when a webcam was unavailable.
Evidence: W3 InventoryReceivingPage.jsx exposed camera and manual input only.
Resolution: Added browser-local PNG/JPG decode through the existing html5-qrcode dependency; 5 MB/type validation; no upload or navigation.
Verification: Chrome desktop selected 01-leading-zeroes.png: decoded 00001234567890; IMAGE_FILE_DECODE 54.3 ms.

Observed problem: Start and cleanup paths had no synchronous operation lock; unmount cleanup also updated React state.
Evidence: W1 and W3 source audit; start functions could enter before the next render and cleanup called setCameraState.
Resolution: Added operation guard, disabled busy actions, mounted guard and state-free unmount cleanup.
Verification: Frontend operation-guard regression test PASS; production build PASS.

Observed problem: Duplicate-item validation was executed inside a React state updater, outside the surrounding synchronous try/catch boundary.
Evidence: W3 addItem used setItems(current => addInventoryItem(...)) inside try/catch.
Resolution: Compute addInventoryItem synchronously before setItems so validation errors reach the visible notice.
Verification: Duplicate Serial/IMEI utility regression test PASS.

Observed problem: The disabled state depended on a later React render, leaving a same-tick repeated-submit window.
Evidence: W3 submitReceipt checked no synchronous in-flight guard.
Resolution: Added a synchronous submit operation guard while retaining the existing idempotency key contract.
Verification: Desktop Chrome invoked submit twice in one tick; one /goods-receipts resource request and one H2 receipt were observed.
